label: Formulated the Ethics of the Real bridging Kantian deontological rigor with the Lacanian death drive
description: Alenka Zupančič formulated and introduced the concept of "Ethics of the Real", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Alenka Zupančič's canonical writings.
